prompt:
Design a beautifully art-directed app-market screenshot template for OneBeat. Portrait 9:16, 1080x1920. This is a complete new visual direction: premium contemporary editorial illustration, warm minimalism, playful street-culture character, elegant controlled composition.

Reference image is ONLY the exact character identity: Lilroll, lavender skin, messy dark-green hair, lime-green skate helmet with black vents and strap, oversized purple hoodie. Keep that identity, relaxed expression and original ink-drawn charm, but redraw the pose. Do not copy the stool, skates or reference's composition.

ART DIRECTION: smooth uncoated warm ivory #F7F1E7 background, almost solid with barely perceptible paper tooth. One large perfectly clean muted coral #EF826F circular color field is cropped off the lower right, just peeking around the phone. One very fine dark curved line follows part of this field, suggesting rhythm. NO splatters, distressed print, noisy halftone, scattered shapes, sparkles, musical notes, confetti, or decorative UI cards. This should feel like a high-end independent music app campaign, sophisticated and friendly.

HERO PHONE: one very large slim matte-graphite smartphone, centered a little to the right, approximately x=245..975,y=330..1810. Front face perfectly planar and upright, no perspective, no rotation. Beautifully precise rounded corners and THIN black frame (~16px), clean subtle metal edge, subtle soft grounding shadow only. The phone should integrate with the illustration rather than look like a chrome product photo. No notch, island, camera hole or status bar. The display MUST be a single uniform pure warm white #FEFDF9 all the way to its inner edges. NO screen reflections, texture, gradients, UI, symbols, text or buttons inside the display. The big screen is the dominant visual and will be filled with real UI later.

CHARACTER / INTERACTION: redraw ONE large Lilroll close-up emerging from lower LEFT. Head including lime helmet roughly 350px wide, around x=-30..335,y=900..1290. Keep most of his face visible to the left of the device; do not hide the eyes. Crop his torso naturally at left and bottom. He looks relaxed and slightly amused, not angry. One purple hand with naturally curved fingers lightly but firmly wraps the phone's LEFT edge around y=1400, fingertips just overlap bezel and up to 20px of screen margin. His other forearm reaches beneath the phone's lower LEFT corner and his upward-facing purple palm supports it from below at x=270..470,y=1810. Both hands must visibly TOUCH the phone; tiny local contact shadows, weight and coherent wrist anatomy. Exactly one character, two connected arms and two hands. Hands feel human-scale relative to face, not gigantic disconnected gloves. His lime helmet and coral circle create an intentional balanced color contrast. The character and phone read as one carefully composed editorial illustration, not a pasted character sticker.

DRAWING: crisp confident dark ink contours, clean cel-shaded color with a little sophisticated hatch on cloth only, beautiful balanced shapes. No shiny plastic 3D cartoon, no airbrushed manga face, no heavy black outer sticker border. Phone is quiet; character has personality; background breathes. Keep top 0..280px completely empty ivory for future headline. Do not render any letters, words, numbers, logos or watermark anywhere. Deliver one refined finished poster, not a contact sheet.
